candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E dey restless or e dey irritable. Eye don sink. If you pinch im skin, e dey normal. E dey drink normally. No blood dey inside stool. E no dey cough or get wahala to breathe. E no get fever. E no get ear problem. E never get convulsion before and e no dey convulse now. E no dey vomit everything. E dey conscious and e no be like person wey dey weak. E fit drink or suck breast.
